{{Quote|I saw beings by the billions undone in cruel and careless instants - by blasters and swords and teeth and fists. I saw fields and forests scoured into ash by orbital bombardments. I saw planetary cores cracked by flights of missiles.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]]|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
A '''planet-cracking missile''' was a type of missile that was used in flights to crack a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] down to its core.

==History==
This type of [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-destroying missile was mentioned in the transcript of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]] regarding his near-[[Death/Legends|death]] experience in the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
No other description of this missile is given, nor the era that it was deployed in. Though this could be a reference to [[baradium missile]]s or other [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] weaponry that have been shown to have the ability to destroy a planet.
